newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnights down on surplus funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnights down on surplus funds.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates closed down on Friday amid surplus liquidity and are likely to open at lower levels on Saturday, dealers said.
"As expected, the overnight market opened on a liquid note," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said. Lenders placed their funds in the range of one to 1.50 percent throughout the day, he added.
As the market closed in surplus, the overnight rates are expected to open at lower levels on Saturday, dealers said.
